en: The maximum number of credentials that can be issued in a single batch request. This helps manage server load and response times.

憑證識別碼

en: A specific identifier for this credential type. This can be used to distinguish between different variants of the same credential type.

en: The Issuer requires a credential offer for this credential configuration.
zh_Hant: 發行者要求此憑證設定必須透過憑證領取邀請發行。

en: The lifetime of the issued credential. After this time, the credential will expire and cannot be refreshed. The wallet can refresh the credential to obtain a new VC as long as this lifetime has not been exceeded.
zh_Hant: 已發行憑證的效期。超過此時間後，憑證將會過期且無法再更新。在效期內，錢包可以更新憑證以取得新的 VC。

en: If enabled, this credential configuration requires cryptographic holder binding and corresponding proofs. If disabled, no cryptographic binding is required and related metadata will be omitted.
zh_Hant: 啟用後，此憑證設定需要以密碼學方式綁定持有者，並提供對應的持有證明。停用時則不需要密碼學綁定，相關的元資料也會省略。

en: Comma-separated list of representations of the cryptographic key material the credential will be bound to (for example: jwk for JWT/SD-JWT VC or cose_key for ISO mDoc). If empty, no cryptographic binding methods will be advertised.
zh_Hant: 以逗號分隔的清單，列出憑證要綁定的密碼學金鑰表示方式（例如 JWT／SD-JWT VC 用 jwk，ISO mDoc 用 cose_key）。留空則不公告任何密碼學綁定方式。
憑證更新間隔

en: How often the wallet should refresh the credential. The actual VC returned to the wallet will have its expiration set to this interval. The refresh token remains valid for the full credential lifetime, allowing regular renewal. If not set, defaults to 7 days or the credential lifetime, whichever is smaller.
zh_Hant: 錢包更新憑證的頻率。發給錢包的 VC 會以此間隔作為到期時間；更新權杖則在整個憑證效期內都有效，以便定期更新。未設定時，預設為 7 天與憑證效期兩者中較短者。

en: Credential refresh interval ({{interval}}) cannot exceed credential lifetime ({{lifetime}}). The refresh token expires with the credential lifetime.
zh_Hant: 憑證更新間隔（{{interval}}）不能超過憑證效期（{{lifetime}}），因為更新權杖會隨憑證效期到期。

en: Signing algorithm used to select the active realm key for signing credentials (e.g., "ES256"). If not specified, the active key will be selected using the realm's default algorithm. This option is disabled if a specific 'Signing Key ID' is selected.
zh_Hant: 用來挑選領域中作用中的金鑰以簽署憑證的簽章演算法（例如「ES256」）。如果未指定，會依領域的預設演算法選擇作用中的金鑰。若已選擇特定的「簽署金鑰 ID」，此選項將停用。

en: Hash algorithm used for SD-JWT credentials (for example "SHA-256"). Defaults to "SHA-256" if not specified.
zh_Hant: 用於 SD-JWT 憑證的雜湊演算法（例如「SHA-256」）。未指定時預設為「SHA-256」。
支援的憑證類型

en: Comma-separated list of credential types (e.g., "VerifiableCredential,UniversityDegreeCredential"). Used in the credential definition for JWT VC and SD-JWT formats. When this option is not configured, the name of the client scope will be used as a 'type' claim of the corresponding credential.
zh_Hant: 以逗號分隔的憑證類型清單（例如「VerifiableCredential,UniversityDegreeCredential」），用於 JWT VC 與 SD-JWT 格式的憑證定義。未設定時，會以用戶端範圍的名稱作為對應憑證的「type」聲明。

en: The credential type identifier for SD-JWT and ISO mDoc format credentials. This value is used in the vct claim of an issued SD-JWT credential and as the doctype of an issued ISO mDoc credential. Required for SD-JWT and ISO mDoc formats.
zh_Hant: SD-JWT 與 ISO mDoc 格式憑證的憑證類型識別碼。此值會寫入已發行 SD-JWT 憑證的 vct 聲明，以及已發行 ISO mDoc 憑證的 doctype。SD-JWT 與 ISO mDoc 格式必須填寫。

en: The configured Token JWS Type does not match the recommended value for the selected credential format. Recommended value: {{recommended}}.
zh_Hant: 設定的權杖 JWS 類型與所選憑證格式的建議值不符。建議值：{{recommended}}。

en: Optional. The ID of the realm key used to sign the credential. If not specified, the realm's active signing key of the algorithm specified by 'Credential Signing Algorithm' (if set) will be used automatically. If a specific key is selected here, the 'Credential Signing Algorithm' option will be disabled and automatically set to the key's algorithm.
zh_Hant: 選填。用於簽署憑證的領域金鑰 ID。如果未指定，會自動使用領域目前作用中、且演算法為「憑證簽章演算法」（如已設定）所指定的簽署金鑰。如果在此選擇特定金鑰，「憑證簽章演算法」選項將會停用，並自動設定為該金鑰的演算法。

en: Object class (or classes) of the group object. It is divided by commas if more classes are needed. In a typical LDAP deployment, it could be 'groupOfNames'. In Active Directory, it is usually 'group'.
zh_Hant: 群組物件的物件類別。如果需要更多類別，則以逗號分隔。在典型的 LDAP 部署中，它可能是「groupOfNames」。在 Active Directory 中，通常是「group」。

en: Object class (or classes) of the role object. It is divided by commas if more classes are needed. In a typical LDAP deployment, it could be 'groupOfNames'. In Active Directory, it is usually 'group'.
zh_Hant: 角色物件的物件類別。如果需要更多類別，則以逗號分隔。在典型的 LDAP 部署中，它可能是「groupOfNames」。在 Active Directory 中，通常是「group」。

en: Name of the LDAP attribute, which is used as the RDN (top attribute) of a typical user DN. It is typically the same attribute as the Username LDAP attribute; however, it is not required. For example, in Active directory, it is common to use 'cn' as the RDN attribute when the username attribute might be 'sAMAccountName'.
zh_Hant: 在典型的使用者 DN 中作為 RDN（頂層屬性）的 LDAP 屬性名稱。通常與使用者名稱 LDAP 屬性相同，但並非必要。例如，在 Active Directory 中，通常會使用「cn」作為 RDN 屬性，而使用者名稱屬性可能是「sAMAccountName」。

en: Name of the LDAP attribute, which is mapped as Keycloak username. For many LDAP server vendors it can be 'uid'. For Active directory it can be 'sAMAccountName' or 'cn'. The attribute should be filled for all LDAP user records you want to import from LDAP to Keycloak.
zh_Hant: LDAP 屬性名稱，對應到 Keycloak 使用者名稱。對於許多 LDAP 伺服器供應商來說，它可以是「uid」。對於 Active Directory，它可以是「sAMAccountName」或「cn」。您想要從 LDAP 匯入到 Keycloak 的所有 LDAP 使用者記錄都應該填寫此屬性。

en: Specify how to retrieve roles of user. LOAD_ROLES_BY_MEMBER_ATTRIBUTE means that roles fo user will be retrieved by sending LDAP query to retrieve all roles where 'member' is our user. GET_ROLES_FROM_USER_MEMBEROF means that roles of user will be retrieved from 'memberOf' attribute of our user. Or from the other attributes specified by 'Member-Of LDAP Attribute'. LOAD_ROLES_BY_MEMBER_ATTRIBUTE is applicable just in Active Directory and it means that roles of user will be retrieved recursively with usage of LDAP_MATCHING_RULE_IN_CHAIN LDAP extension.
zh_Hant: 指定如何取得使用者的角色。LOAD_ROLES_BY_MEMBER_ATTRIBUTE 表示會傳送 LDAP 查詢，取得所有「member」為該使用者的角色。GET_ROLES_FROM_USER_MEMBEROF 表示會從該使用者的「memberOf」屬性，或「Member-Of LDAP 屬性」所指定的其他屬性中取得使用者的角色。LOAD_ROLES_BY_MEMBER_ATTRIBUTE 僅適用於 Active Directory，表示會使用 LDAP_MATCHING_RULE_IN_CHAIN LDAP 擴充遞迴取得使用者的角色。

en: User federation provides access to external databases and directories, such as LDAP and Active Directory.
zh_Hant: 使用者聯合可存取外部資料庫和目錄，例如 LDAP 和 Active Directory。

en: Name of the LDAP attribute, which is used as a unique object identifier (UUID) for objects in LDAP. For many LDAP server vendors, it is 'entryUUID'; however some are different. For example, for Active directory it should be 'objectGUID'. If your LDAP server does not support the notion of UUID, you can use any other attribute that is supposed to be unique among LDAP users in tree. For example 'uid' or 'entryDN'.
zh_Hant: LDAP 屬性的名稱，用於作為 LDAP 中物件的唯一物件識別碼 (UUID)。對於許多 LDAP 伺服器供應商來說，它是「entryUUID」；然而有些則不同。例如，對於 Active Directory，它應該是「objectGUID」。如果您的 LDAP 伺服器不支援 UUID 的概念，您可以使用任何其他屬性，該屬性應該在 LDAP 使用者樹中是唯一的。例如「uid」或「entryDN」。
